description:
Dossier for Government is a cloud-based competency and training management solution for federal agencies. It replaces paper competency folders with a single system of record for defining the competencies each role requires, assessing staff against those requirements on recurring cycles, delivering the training that closes the gaps, and producing current competency status on demand at the team, facility, or department level.

The service is built for federal workforces with recurring, externally driven competency obligations — including clinical and nursing education staff, and healthcare technology management personnel responsible for maintaining and repairing medical equipment. Assessment schedules, advance notifications, and overdue flags are tracked by the system rather than depending on manual review of paper files.

**Services included**

- **Dossier Profile** — the core competency management service. Role-based competency definitions and assigned core tasks, assessments with assessor sign-off and proficiency ratings, configurable reassessment cycles, supporting attachments, automated notification of upcoming and overdue assessments, dashboards and reporting, role-based access control, and audit logging.
- **Dossier Learn** — an integrated learning management system. Course and training assignment, delivery, and completion tracking, linked to the competency requirements held in Dossier Profile.
- **Dossier Development Program** — structured career development supporting clinical ladder programs. Defined advancement levels and criteria, evidence submission against those criteria, and review and progression tracking.

**Security category.** Each included service is categorized Low under FIPS 199 for confidentiality, integrity, and availability.

**Information handled.** Dossier for Government holds employee competency, training, and development records: employee name, work email address, job title and role, facility and organizational unit, assigned core tasks, competency ratings, assessment and due dates, assessor identity, training and course completion records, development program submissions, supporting attachments such as checklists and certifications, account role assignment, and audit logs of user activity.

The service is not intended to hold protected health information, patient or beneficiary records, clinical or treatment data, controlled unclassified information, Social Security numbers, or financial or payment data. Permitted use is defined in the terms of service and in the Secure Configuration Guide.

Dossier for Government is delivered as multi-tenant SaaS.

description:
KnowBe4 is the world's most popular integrated Security Awareness Training and Simulated Phishing platform with thousands of active enterprise accounts. You finally have a platform to better manage the urgent IT security problems of social engineering, phishing and ransomware attacks. KnowBe4 gives you self-service enrollment, and both pre-and post-training phishing security tests that show you the percentage of end-users that are Phish-prone. Our highly effective, frequent, "double-random" Phishing Security Tests provide several remedial options in case an employee falls for a simulated phishing attack.

KnowBe4 provides you with the world's largest library of 800+ security awareness training content, including interactive modules, videos, games, posters and newsletters. You can schedule regular Phishing Security Tests from our large library of over 2,500 "known-to-work" templates or you can also create your own custom phishing templates. And with our powerful Smart Groups feature, you can use each employees' behavior and user attributes to tailor phishing campaigns, training assignments, remedial learning and reporting. Your enterprise can get the KnowBe4 platform quickly deployed into production. Our Customer Success team gets you going in no time, without the need for consulting hours. And our Active Directory Integration (ADI) allows you to easily sync user data and saves you time by eliminating the need to manually manage user changes. Once the ADI is configured, users will be added, changed and archived in sync with changes made within AD automatically.

We use FedRAMP compliant Amazon Web Services East (AWS US East), which is maintained in an ISO certified facility. There is no unauthorized external access to data, we only store just enough information to accomplish the services we are set to provide, which minimally are email addresses with recorded clicks. All email addresses are encrypted and kept private. And KnowBe4 has been PCI compliant from day one. KnowBe4 courses are SCORM compliant, so we can deliver courseware for your in-house LMS if needed. However, KnowBe4 does have its own LMS that lives in the cloud, and we can report back to you about all enrolled employees, their status, completion, and many other parameters.

description:
Toonimo is a cloud-native SaaS digital adoption platform that delivers in-application walkthroughs, AI chatbot and voicebot guidance, process intelligence, and analytics so organizations can help employees and constituents complete tasks in existing web applications. The FedRAMP authorization boundary is commercial Amazon Web Services only (containers on Kubernetes/EKS, managed database, object storage, CDN, WAF, KMS). Oracle Cloud Infrastructure is used for some commercial non-federal tenants and is outside this boundary.

Target certification: FedRAMP 20x Class C (Moderate) via Program Certification (no agency sponsor). Marketplace status: Initial Implementation. FedRAMP ID pending assignment.
